root_cause: release.json used the exact deployment SHA but the final built HTML was not re-stamped after all page transformers, so live-contract readback saw an older bg-release-commit marker.
The mobile i18n injector only supported aside.v18-mobile-drawer, while pricing can use the compact #bgkopMob/.bgkop-mob drawer, leaving no visible mobile language select.
prevention: Stamp every final built HTML document with ensureReleaseMarker(html, commitRef) in the last release-evidence boundary.
Mobile language injection must support every canonical public mobile drawer variant and remain data-bg-no-translate.
Terminal production truth requires release.json exact SHA, HTML release marker exact SHA, pricing interaction proof, and NL→EN→NL browser roundtrip.
